children: Stewards received Nasdaq approval to list its common stock and expects trading to begin on Nasdaq under the symbol SWRD on Sept. 10, 2026.
Nasdaq Listing: Listing Qualifications approved Stewards’ common stock for the Nasdaq Capital Market.
Form 8-A Filed: Company filed Form 8-A12B to register common stock under Section 12(b); Nasdaq submitted certification.
Trading Start: Common stock expected to commence trading on Nasdaq under “SWRD” at market open on Sept. 10, 2026.
OTC Cessation: Quotation on the OTCID Market will cease at the close of trading on Sept. 9, 2026.
No Offering: The listing does not involve a concurrent public offering; CUSIP remains 312084106.
